content.text: When Jesus realized that the Pharisees were aware He was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John

footnotes.text: Literally When therefore Jesus knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus; NE, WH, BYZ, and TR When therefore the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus

content.text: (although it was not Jesus who baptized, but His disciples),
He left Judea and returned to Galilee.
Jesus told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”

“I have no husband,” the woman replied.
Jesus said to her, “You are correct to say that you have no husband.
In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.”
